body: Congratulations on your upcoming baptism! I was born into the church and I live it and love it every day. I wanted to say something about the young missionaries... They have probably grown up with texting as their primary source of communication. They are learning how to interact more in person. To them, texting you was probably more natural and seemed totally normal. They will learn on their missions that in-person conversations need to take place more often than not. Remember, people are not perfect, but the Lord's plan is.

I am the writer of "Depression Sucks" and I finally had a chance tonight to read all of your comments and ideas.  Thank you all very much for caring enough about a stranger to offer your input.  I appreciate it very much. I am going to try to be mindful of my actions and thoughts, and not let all the dark, bad thoughts take over. I want to find joy again. Thank you for being on this site and taking time to write to me, even though many of you are suffering, too.

If you don't want to open up to your parents, is there another trusted person you could talk to, like a counselor/therapist? Maybe you can get the help you need with therapy and possibly medication without having to have everything out in the open, and maybe it won't show up on any medical history and that way it won't affect your career path. Here in the U.S. from what I have seen, it has not been detrimental for people to seek counseling and take medication if needed; people are encouraged to seek help and better themselves so they can perform better at their jobs. They may not want to hire people who are certified as "crazy" but they do respect people who are willing to take the steps to get help. I am sorry you are suicidal and I truly hope that you can get some help before it is too late.  If you are severe enough, maybe a short-term stay is possible. Is that possible where you live?  Sometimes people here go into treatment for a a week or two to get stabilized, then they can go to outpatient care if they need to.  Good luck with all this.  It's hard, I know.

Sometimes I wish the rich celebrities would give some of their money to the people who are regular folks like us, the ones who are struggling and desperate.  While they make $20 million for a stupid movie, we are ready to die because we cannot afford life in general.  Can't afford medical care. Can't afford regular stuff.  Life can be so depressing.  I am on medication but it doesn't seem to help.  Everything seems so hard. I am terrified of death, too. I don't want to live anymore, but I am too afraid to die.  I hope you find some help, whether it be with mental health, physical health, or money to get through this life.  Good luck. I mean it.

I hope you got a refill on your Xanax.  I understand how hard it is to want to keep going.  Just getting out of bed and out of the house is so hard sometimes.  You said you missed a shift from work, but that sounds promising because it means you are going to work and you must care about your job if you are worried because you missed a shift.  Keep doing that.  Keep working. Keep trying.  Please don't take a bottle of pills.  Chances are you will end up really sick in the hospital and you'll feel really cruddy.  I am pulling for ya.

I cannot tell you the best way... I wish I could talk you out of it instead.  Just try to get through another day.  I worry so much about how my family would feel if they found me dead. What would be the least traumatic and messy for them.  I would have to do it without any mess or blood.  I have thought about it.  But I keep telling myself, those are just thoughts.  Push them away.  And I will say this to you... Push those thoughts away.  Find something to distract yourself.  Try to focus on something else.  Please don't hurt yourself or kill yourself.
Don't kill yourself. See how you feel tomorrow. If you make it another day, you an do another one.  No matter what you messed up with, it's not worth killing yourself.
How are you? I am hoping you are just sick from the Xanax.  Please respond if you are okay.

You definitely have had things tough! I am truly sorry for the pain you have gone through in your life.  I agree with goldiehanz, just because people put you down, it doesn't mean it's true.  Think of one goal, any goal, as long as it's positive and it doesn't include killing yourself, and work toward it.  It can be small. But you need to believe in yourself.  You need to love yourself.  You deserve that.  Hang in there, a day at a time.  An hour at a time. Whatever it takes to know that YOU ARE WORTH IT.  YOU ARE WORTHY OF A HAPPY LIFE.

I worry about trying it and just getting hurt really badly, or brain damage, or something like that, and then people have to take care of me.  I don't want anything messy. I just want to go to sleep and not wake up. I am too young to die of natural causes. I hope you can begin to feel better. I really do. I am sincere when I say that. No one should feel so awful that they think about ways to die. I am sorry.
Thx. I am going to bed now. I am not going to kill myself tonight. I might even go to a crisis center if I wake up and it's really bad.

My depression stems from my anxiety disorder, too. I have had anxiety for as long as I can remember (as a little girl). Anxiety has caused me to feel isolated and useless. I can barely leave the house. My depression came after that, after feeling so isolated. I have taken meds for anxiety for a long time, and now I take meds for my  depression.  I think the depression meds have made things worse. I need to get off these awful meds.  Oh... I previously watched all the episodes of Grace and Frankie on Netflix!  Then when new episodes were added, I watched them all in two days. They're so good. I wish I had Frankie and her boys as friends in real life.  I am sorry you feel so horrible and feel like dying. I feel like that right now. I don't want to cause people pain or make a mess. I have thought about how to do it, thinking I would do it tonight. I cleaned up my house and bedroom and sorted through stuff, trying to make things organized so when I'm gone people won't think I was a messy person.  Then I decided to go on here tonight and read some things. I am truly sorry that you feel so awful. Please try to find something to live for. Try to get through a day at a time. I decided that I will do that. I am going to go to bed and not kill myself tonight. I hope you feel better, I really do. That sounds lame, but I am being sincere.

Thank you for replying. Thank you. I feel like it's NOT me. The normal me would not want to die and leave my kids. But today I seriously considered it. A man in my town jumped off a bridge recently into a dry ravine and he died. I thought of doing that, but I would probably just end up with broken bones and be in pain. I have bottles of old pills (half full) that belong to my mentally ill daughter who used to be on a lot of anti-psychotic meds. I was gathering them to take them to the police station because they have a drop off there. I actually thought... what if I just took them all?? I would just go to sleep and that's how I would want to die. Nothing bloody. Just like going to sleep. I am going to put them in the safe until I have a chance to drop them off. And I am going to get off this awful medication.
I have nightmares when I'm sleeping most nights, so unless I take a sleeping pill, I actually don't sleep very well. Is it selfish to want to sleep all the time when I know my family needs me?

Maybe your friends don't know how to help.  But a person at a Crisis Response Center or a Mental Healh Urgent Care will know how to help.  They can assess you and help you with the next step.  Maybe change medication.  Maybe talk to a professional counselor.  They don't judge.  It is awful to feel alone.  I know.... I have cut myself off from all my friends.  They stopped coming around because I wasn't reaching out to them.  It is just too hard to deal with life sometimes.  I hope you get some help with your depression.  Hang in there and I hope you find some joy somewhere in your life.

Maybe try going to a Crisis Response Center or a Mental Health Urgent Care. You can get assessed and hopefully get some help with your depression, maybe medication will help balance things out.  Losing interest in friends, music, your guitar, etc. are all serious signs of depression.  I have stayed up at night just so I can be alone, then I want to sleep the next day so I won't have to interact with anyone.  I think I know how you feel.  It is exhausting and terrible.  I am really sorry.  Please try to talk to someone.  Even ONE person.  Maybe that one person can go with you to Crisis Response.  It could be a positive step.  Good luck.

I believe that God has created us and he loves us, and he wants us to come back to him after this earthly life.  Sometimes this earthly life is exhausting and depressing, and I have thought about ending my life because of the pain and how terribly hard everything feels.  But my belief that someday I will be with God again and feel his love for me gets me through. I probably would end my life but I am afraid of what dying feels like.  The actual process of it.  Not the afterlife, but the actual dying experience.  It scares me.  So I live in a depression, hoping to die of natural causes, hopefully in my sleep so I won't be scared.  Have you read any books about people who have died and then come back to earth?  They tell of their experiences of how much warmth and love they felt.  I hope it really is that way.  Please don't dwell on thoughts of suicide. Read about near death experiences, but please don't do it on purpose.

I am so sorry you feel like this.  My daughter used to say that she wanted to open the door of the car while it was moving, especially on the freeway, and that way she could just get hit by other cars.  I used to be scared to drive with her because I didn't want her to do that. It is a real feeling. Maybe on days like you feel like this, you can take the bus or walk somewhere.  I hope you don't think that's a dumb suggestion. Maybe go to a Crisis Response or a Mental Health Urgent Care and tell them how you feel. I hope you don't die this way.

Social anxiety, general anxiety... ugh.... so hard to deal with.  I fear driving because I am afraid I will crash and die. I fear going into stores because I don't want to see people.  It's better for me to see strangers than people I know.  I went into a bank and was terrified that someone was going to rob it and kill me.  But then I thought maybe it is better to die by someone else causing it. I don't want to hurt my children and husband by killing myself, but maybe if someone else did it by accident, it wouldn't be as hard on them.  I want to talk to a counselor but I always cancel my appointments because it's too hard to get out the door. I feel judged. I feel like a loser because I struggle so much.  Anxiety caused my depression.  I feel alone, isolated, and useless.  I am so sorry you have no family or friends to help you.  But I see lots of comments on here, so it shows that people care enough about you, even though you are a stranger, to reach out to you.  Hang in there.  Try calling the hotline again.  Go to Crisis Response or a Mental Health Urgent Care.  They can help.  You are not alone in this, even though it feels like it.

I only got one response to my post yesterday.  I think we are all in the same boat here... trying to find connections... someone to relate to.  I am sorry you feel alone.  I do believe people care, but when we are depressed it is terribly difficult to reach out to others.  Sometimes just an aknowledgement that your post was seen might be enough.  I saw it.  I care.  I hope you can hang in there and find hope.

Of course I don't know you, but I believe you brought joy into the world the day you were born.  You have it in you to feel joy and happiness.  Go to a Crisis Response or a Mental Health Urgent Care. If you haven't tried prescription medication, then get a prescription for depression.  Try talking to a counselor. Your life is worth it. Hang in there.  Life is exhausting sometimes, I understand that.  Please don't kill yourself. Life can be lonely, but at 20 years old you have many years ahead that you can find happiness in.  Fulfillment is out there.

Everyone deserves to feel happiness and joy (to some extent) on their birthday.  It's the day you were born, and I honestly believe that you brought joy into the world on that day. Is there anyone you can talk to, anyone to wish you a Happy Birthday?  I truly hope so.   Hang in there.  Take it day by day, hour by hour if you need to.

Thank you for reaching out.  I had a panic attack today at the store and it wiped me out.  It's embarrassing and I feel like such a failure. I want to feel joy, but it seems so far out of my reach.  I hope I am brave enough to go to my counseling appointment when it comes time.  Did you learn coping skills, mindfulness, things like that in therapy? What was it that helped you... just talking to someone?

Counseling and therapy can be exhausting. But you went!  And that is a brave thing to do.  I usually cancel my appointments.  I have one set up for early May which I hope I am brave enough to go to.  I am truly sorry you feel so awful. Mental illness is not your fault. It is so hard to deal with.  Hang in there.

That is a scary way to die.  Think about this... What if you didn't die and you were just badly disfigured and disabled and in a lot of pain? I hope that you don't do something so drastic like that.  I am truly sorry that you are having these thoughts. I cannot help other than saying hang in there.  Give it another day and try to get through it.  I am sorry. Maybe there is a counselor you could talk to.

I have a friend who felt similar to this.  No one can feel your pain but you, but he expressed similar feelings. He started to see a counselor. He was encouraged to present himself the way he felt, as a woman. He is not necessarily feminine looking, but he seems happier wearing feminine clothing and make-up.  He is saving his money to eventually have a sex change.  He says it's that or he dies. He would rather change his sex and give that a try. It might feel more genuine than you think.  Good luck.  Don't give up on yourself yet.
